date_trunc('hour', tm) + MAKE_INTERVAL(mins => FLOOR(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM tm) / #{bucketMinutes})::int * #{bucketMinutes})
mapper.select: SELECT , tm AS "collectTime" FROM rms_metric_log WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} ORDER BY tm DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT , tm AS "collectTime" FROM rms_metric_log WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} ORDER BY tm DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

SELECT instance_id AS "instanceId", AS "bucket",
AVG((io_iik)::numeric) AS "inValue", AVG((io_iok)::numeric) AS "outValue"
AVG(CASE WHEN #{metricKey} = 'cpuUsage' THEN (cpu_per)::numeric WHEN #{metricKey} = 'serverMemUsage' THEN (mem_server_per)::numeric WHEN #{metricKey} = 'redisMemUsed' THEN (mem_us)::numeric/1024.0/1024/1024 WHEN #{metricKey} = 'qps' THEN (ops)::numeric WHEN #{metricKey} = 'avgLatency' THEN (latency)::numeric WHEN #{metricKey} = 'netInputBandwidth' THEN (io_iik)::numeric WHEN #{metricKey} = 'netOutputBandwidth' THEN (io_iok)::numeric END) AS "value"
FROM rms_metric_log WHERE instance_id IN #{id} AND tm BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY bucket

SELECT AVG((cpu_per)::numeric) AS "cpuAvg", MAX((cpu_per)::numeric) AS "cpuMax", (SELECT tm FROM rms_metric_log WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND tm BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} ORDER BY (cpu_per)::numeric DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS "cpuMaxTim", AVG((mem_us)::numeric)/1024.0/1024/1024 AS "redisMemAvg", MAX((mem_us)::numeric)/1024.0/1024/1024 AS "redisMemMax", (SELECT tm FROM rms_metric_log WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND tm BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} ORDER BY (mem_us)::numeric DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS "redisMemMaxTim", AVG((ops)::numeric) AS "qpsAvg", MAX((ops)::numeric) AS "qpsMax", (SELECT tm FROM rms_metric_log WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND tm BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} ORDER BY (ops)::numeric DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS "qpsMaxTim", AVG((latency)::numeric) AS "latencyAvg", MAX((latency)::numeric) AS "latencyMax", (SELECT tm FROM rms_metric_log WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND tm BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} ORDER BY (latency)::numeric DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS "latencyMaxTim", COUNT(*) AS "collectCount" FROM rms_metric_log WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND tm BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}

SELECT date_trunc('day', tm)
AS "bucket", AVG((cpu_per)::numeric) AS "cpuUsage", AVG((mem_us)::numeric)/1024.0/1024/1024 AS "redisMemUsed", AVG((ops)::numeric) AS "qps", AVG((latency)::numeric) AS "avgLatency" FROM rms_metric_log WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND tm BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT id, instance_id, instance_name, host_ip, redis_port, role, redis_version, run_status, master_host_ip, master_redis_port, last_heartbeat_time, management_status, created_time, updated_time FROM redis_instance WHERE management_status = #{managementStatus} ORDER BY instance_name ASC
